responsibility: Builds and emits AST-conversion diagnostics for invalid type paths and bounds, including missing generic arguments, incorrect `Fn`-trait syntax, unresolved or mismatched associated items, forbidden associated type bindings, and related recovery suggestions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `errors.rs`, this file contains the `AstConv`-specific diagnostic construction logic: it emits and shapes errors encountered while lowering paths, generic arguments, `Fn`-trait syntax, and associated-item/type-binding syntax during AST-to-`ty` conversion.
